title: Accidental inventions
text: Some of the most famous inventions in history were mistakes. The inventors were looking for something else, but they were curious, so they found something new.

In 1928 Alexander Fleming went on holiday and left some dishes with bacteria in his laboratory. When he came back, he saw a strange mold on one of them. The bacteria around the mold were dead, so Fleming studied it. It was penicillin, the first antibiotic. It saved millions of lives.

In 1945 an engineer called Percy Spencer was working with radar machines. Suddenly he noticed that the chocolate bar in his pocket was melting. He was surprised, so he tried with popcorn. The popcorn exploded! This is how he invented the microwave oven.

In 1968 a scientist tried to make a very strong glue, but his glue was weak. Years later, a colleague wanted bookmarks that did not fall from his book, so he used the weak glue. That was the beginning of sticky notes.
Even the potato chip was an accident. A customer said that the potatoes in a restaurant were too thick, so the chef cut them very thin and fried them. The customer loved them!
q: What did Fleming leave in his laboratory?
What happened to the chocolate in the pocket of Spencer?
Why was the glue useful for bookmarks?
Why did the chef cut the potatoes very thin?
A customer said they were too thick

grammar.title: Grammar: because and so
grammar.rule: Use because to give a reason. Use so to give a result.
rows: He studied it because the bacteria were dead.
The bacteria were dead, so he studied it.
I was hungry, so I ate.
I ate because I was hungry.
items: He was surprised, ___ he tried with popcorn.
The glue was useful ___ it was weak.
The potatoes were thick, ___ the chef cut them thin.
Fleming studied the mold ___ it was strange.
They were curious, ___ they found something new.

es.title: Inventos por accidente
es.grammar: Gramática: because y so. Because (porque) da la causa; so (así que) da el resultado.
rows: Lo estudió porque las bacterias estaban muertas.
Las bacterias estaban muertas, así que lo estudió.
